question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate choice.

The issue of fairness, which remained, was for consideration at the hearing to _____ the scheme.
solution:
The correct answer is "**sanction**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "sanction."**
 
• **The word "sanction" means to give official permission or approval.(**प्रतिबंध)
 
• In this context, the hearing will consider whether the scheme is fair and deserving of official approval.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• The issue of fairness, which remained, was for consideration at the hearing to sanction__ the scheme. 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The word **"stratification"** means the division of something into layers or levels.(स्तर-विन्यास)
 
• The word **"acclamation"** means loud and enthusiastic approval or praise.(अभिनंदन)
 
• The word **"altercation"** means a noisy argument or disagreement.(तकरार)
